028  private static final long[] m_metadataCache = new long[7];

031  static int availableToCount(long available) {
032    // Top bit has to be set
033    if (available < 0) {
034      return 64;
035    }
036
037    int count = 0;
038
039    // Top bit not set, we will eventually get a 0 bit
040    while ((available & 0x1) != 0) {
041      count++;
042      available >>= 1;
043    }
044    return count;
045  }

173  /**
174   * The state of one joystick button.
175   *
176   * @param stick The joystick to read.
177   * @param button The button index.
178   * @return The state of the joystick button.
179   */
180  public static boolean getStickButton(final int stick, final int button) {
181    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
182      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
183    }
184    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
185      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
186    }
187
188    long mask = 1L << button;
189
190    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
191    try {
192      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
193        return (m_joystickButtons[stick].m_buttons & mask) != 0;
194      }
195    } finally {
196      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
197    }
198
199    JoystickAlerts.reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.BUTTON, button);
200    return false;
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * The state of one joystick button if available.
205   *
206   * @param stick The joystick to read.
207   * @param button The button index.
208   * @return The state of the joystick button, or false if the button is not available.
209   */
210  public static Optional<Boolean> getStickButtonIfAvailable(final int stick, final int button) {
211    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
212      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
213    }
214    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
215      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
216    }
217
218    long mask = 1L << button;
219
220    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
221    try {
222      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
223        return Optional.of((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_buttons & mask) != 0);
224      }
225    } finally {
226      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
227    }
228    return Optional.empty();
229  }

231  /**
232   * Whether one joystick button was pressed since the last check.
233   *
234   * @param stick The joystick to read.
235   * @param button The button index.
236   * @return Whether the joystick button was pressed since the last check.
237   */
238  public static boolean getStickButtonPressed(final int stick, final int button) {
239    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
240      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
241    }
242    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
243      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
244    }
245
246    long mask = 1L << button;
247
248    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
249    try {
250      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
251        // If button was pressed, clear flag and return true
252        if ((m_joystickButtonsPressed[stick] & mask) != 0) {
253          m_joystickButtonsPressed[stick] &= ~mask;
254          return true;
255        } else {
256          return false;
257        }
258      }
259    } finally {
260      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
261    }
262
263    JoystickAlerts.reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.BUTTON, button);
264    return false;
265  }
266
267  /**
268   * Whether one joystick button was released since the last check.
269   *
270   * @param stick The joystick to read.
271   * @param button The button index, beginning at 0.
272   * @return Whether the joystick button was released since the last check.
273   */
274  public static boolean getStickButtonReleased(final int stick, final int button) {
275    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
276      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
277    }
278    if (button < 0 || button >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_BUTTONS) {
279      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick Button is out of range");
280    }
281
282    long mask = 1L << button;
283
284    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
285    try {
286      if ((m_joystickButtons[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
287        // If button was released, clear flag and return true
288        if ((m_joystickButtonsReleased[stick] & mask) != 0) {
289          m_joystickButtonsReleased[stick] &= ~mask;
290          return true;
291        } else {
292          return false;
293        }
294      }
295    } finally {
296      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
297    }
298
299    JoystickAlerts.reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.BUTTON, button);
300    return false;
301  }

303  /**
304   * Get the value of the axis on a joystick. This depends on the mapping of the joystick connected
305   * to the specified port.
306   *
307   * @param stick The joystick to read.
308   * @param axis The analog axis value to read from the joystick.
309   * @return The value of the axis on the joystick.
310   */
311  public static double getStickAxis(int stick, int axis) {
312    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
313      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
314    }
315    if (axis < 0 || axis >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_AXES) {
316      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick axis is out of range");
317    }
318
319    int mask = 1 << axis;
320
321    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
322    try {
323      if ((m_joystickAxes[stick].m_available & mask) != 0) {
324        return m_joystickAxes[stick].m_axes[axis];
325      }
326    } finally {
327      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
328    }
329
330    JoystickAlerts.reportJoystickResourceWarning(stick, JoystickResourceAlert.AXIS, axis);
331    return 0.0;
332  }

334  /**
335   * Get the state of a touchpad finger on the joystick.
336   *
337   * @param stick The joystick to read.
338   * @param touchpad The touchpad to read.
339   * @param finger The finger to read.
340   * @return the state of the touchpad finger.
341   */
342  public static TouchpadFinger getStickTouchpadFinger(int stick, int touchpad, int finger) {
343    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
344      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
345    }
346    if (touchpad < 0 || touchpad >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPADS) {
347      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad is out of range");
348    }
349    if (finger < 0 || finger >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPAD_FINGERS) {
350      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad finger is out of range");
351    }
352
353    int touchpadCount;
354    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
355    try {
356      touchpadCount = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_count;
357      if (touchpad < touchpadCount) {
358        HALJoystickTouchpad tp = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_touchpads[touchpad];
359        if (finger < tp.m_count) {
360          return new TouchpadFinger(
361              tp.m_fingers[finger].m_down, tp.m_fingers[finger].m_x, tp.m_fingers[finger].m_y);
362        }
363      }
364    } finally {
365      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
366    }
367
368    JoystickAlerts.reportJoystickTouchpadFingerWarning(stick, touchpad, finger);
369    return new TouchpadFinger(false, 0.0f, 0.0f);
370  }
371
372  /**
373   * Get whether a touchpad finger on the joystick is available.
374   *
375   * @param stick The joystick to read.
376   * @param touchpad The touchpad to read.
377   * @param finger The finger to read.
378   * @return whether the touchpad finger is available.
379   */
380  public static boolean getStickTouchpadFingerAvailable(int stick, int touchpad, int finger) {
381    if (stick < 0 || stick >= JOYSTICK_PORTS) {
382      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick index is out of range, should be 0-5");
383    }
384    if (touchpad < 0 || touchpad >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPADS) {
385      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad is out of range");
386    }
387    if (finger < 0 || finger >= DriverStationJNI.MAX_JOYSTICK_TOUCHPAD_FINGERS) {
388      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Joystick touchpad finger is out of range");
389    }
390
391    int touchpadCount;
392    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
393    try {
394      touchpadCount = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_count;
395      if (touchpad < touchpadCount) {
396        HALJoystickTouchpad tp = m_joystickTouchpads[stick].m_touchpads[touchpad];
397        if (finger < tp.m_count) {
398          return true;
399        }
400      }
401    } finally {
402      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
403    }
404
405    return false;
406  }

630  /**
631   * Returns if a joystick is connected to the Driver Station.
632   *
633   * <p>This makes a best effort guess by looking at the reported number of axis, buttons, and POVs
634   * attached.
635   *
636   * @param stick The joystick port number
637   * @return true if a joystick is connected
638   */
639  public static boolean isJoystickConnected(int stick) {
640    return getStickAxesAvailable(stick) != 0
641        || getStickButtonsAvailable(stick) != 0
642        || getStickPOVsAvailable(stick) != 0;
643  }

669   * connected to the FMS.
670   *
671   * @return Whether joystick connection alerts are silenced.
672   */
673  public static boolean isJoystickConnectionAlertSilenced() {
674    return JoystickAlerts.isJoystickConnectionAlertSilenced();
675  }

677  /**
678   * Refresh the passed in control word to contain the current control word cache.
679   *
680   * @param word Word to refresh.
681   */
682  public static void refreshControlWordFromCache(ControlWord word) {
683    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
684    try {
685      word.update(m_controlWord);
686    } finally {
687      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
688    }
689  }

691  /**
692   * Copy data from the DS task for the user. If no new data exists, it will just be returned,
693   * otherwise the data will be copied from the DS polling loop.
694   */
695  @SuppressWarnings("VariableDeclarationUsageDistance")
696  public static void refreshData() {
697    DriverStationJNI.refreshDSData();
698
699    // Get the status of all the joysticks
700    for (byte stick = 0; stick < JOYSTICK_PORTS; stick++) {
701      DriverStationJNI.getAllJoystickData(
702          stick,
703          m_joystickAxesCache[stick].m_axes,
704          m_joystickAxesRawCache[stick].m_axes,
705          m_joystickPOVsCache[stick].m_povs,
706          m_touchpadFingersCache,
707          m_metadataCache);
708      m_joystickAxesCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[0];
709      m_joystickAxesRawCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[0];
710      m_joystickPOVsCache[stick].m_available = (int) m_metadataCache[1];
711      m_joystickButtonsCache[stick].m_available = m_metadataCache[2];
712      m_joystickButtonsCache[stick].m_buttons = m_metadataCache[3];
713      m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_count = (int) m_metadataCache[4];
714      for (int i = 0; i < m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_count; i++) {
715        long metadata = m_metadataCache[5 + i];
716        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[0].m_down = (metadata & 0x1) != 0;
717        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[1].m_down = (metadata & 0x2) != 0;
718        m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_count = (int) (metadata >> 2 & 0x3);
719        for (int j = 0; j < m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_count; j++) {
720          m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[j].m_x =
721              m_touchpadFingersCache[i * 4 + j * 2 + 0];
722          m_joystickTouchpadsCache[stick].m_touchpads[i].m_fingers[j].m_y =
723              m_touchpadFingersCache[i * 4 + j * 2 + 1];
724        }
725      }
726    }
727
728    // This is a pass through, so if it hasn't changed, it doesn't
729    // reallocate
730    m_gameDataCache = DriverStationJNI.getGameData(m_gameDataCache);
731    MatchState.refreshMatchInfo(m_gameDataCache);
732
733    DriverStationJNI.getControlWord(m_controlWordCache);
734
735    DataLogSender dataLogSender;
736    // lock joystick mutex to swap cache data
737    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
738    try {
739      for (int i = 0; i < JOYSTICK_PORTS; i++) {
740        // If buttons weren't pressed and are now, set flags in m_buttonsPressed
741        m_joystickButtonsPressed[i] |=
742            ~m_joystickButtons[i].m_buttons & m_joystickButtonsCache[i].m_buttons;
743
744        // If buttons were pressed and aren't now, set flags in m_buttonsReleased
745        m_joystickButtonsReleased[i] |=
746            m_joystickButtons[i].m_buttons & ~m_joystickButtonsCache[i].m_buttons;
747      }
748
749      // move cache to actual data
750      HALJoystickAxes[] currentAxes = m_joystickAxes;
751      m_joystickAxes = m_joystickAxesCache;
752      m_joystickAxesCache = currentAxes;
753
754      HALJoystickAxesRaw[] currentAxesRaw = m_joystickAxesRaw;
755      m_joystickAxesRaw = m_joystickAxesRawCache;
756      m_joystickAxesRawCache = currentAxesRaw;
757
758      HALJoystickButtons[] currentButtons = m_joystickButtons;
759      m_joystickButtons = m_joystickButtonsCache;
760      m_joystickButtonsCache = currentButtons;
761
762      HALJoystickPOVs[] currentPOVs = m_joystickPOVs;
763      m_joystickPOVs = m_joystickPOVsCache;
764      m_joystickPOVsCache = currentPOVs;
765
766      HALJoystickTouchpads[] currentTouchpads = m_joystickTouchpads;
767      m_joystickTouchpads = m_joystickTouchpadsCache;
768      m_joystickTouchpadsCache = currentTouchpads;
769
770      ControlWord currentWord = m_controlWord;
771      m_controlWord = m_controlWordCache;
772      m_controlWordCache = currentWord;
773
774      dataLogSender = m_dataLogSender;
775    } finally {
776      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
777    }
778
779    RobotState.refreshData();
780    JoystickAlerts.clearJoystickAlerts();
781
782    m_refreshEvents.wakeup();
783
784    m_matchDataSender.sendMatchData(m_controlWord, m_gameDataCache);
785    if (dataLogSender != null) {
786      dataLogSender.send(
787          m_controlWord, m_joystickButtons, m_joystickAxes, m_joystickPOVs, WPIUtilJNI.now());
788    }
789  }

791  /**
792   * Registers the given handle for DS data refresh notifications.
793   *
794   * @param handle The event handle.
795   */
796  public static void provideRefreshedDataEventHandle(int handle) {
797    m_refreshEvents.add(handle);
798  }
799
800  /**
801   * Unregisters the given handle from DS data refresh notifications.
802   *
803   * @param handle The event handle.
804   */
805  public static void removeRefreshedDataEventHandle(int handle) {
806    m_refreshEvents.remove(handle);
807  }

809  /**
810   * Starts logging DriverStation data to data log. Repeated calls are ignored.
811   *
812   * @param log data log
813   * @param logJoysticks if true, log joystick data
814   */
815  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.NonThreadSafeSingleton")
816  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log, boolean logJoysticks) {
817    m_cacheDataMutex.lock();
818    try {
819      if (m_dataLogSender == null) {
820        m_dataLogSender =
821            new DataLogSender(
822                log,
823                logJoysticks,
824                m_controlWord,
825                m_joystickButtons,
826                m_joystickAxes,
827                m_joystickPOVs,
828                WPIUtilJNI.now());
829      }
830    } finally {
831      m_cacheDataMutex.unlock();
832    }
833  }
834
835  /**
836   * Starts logging DriverStation data to data log, including joystick data. Repeated calls are
837   * ignored.
838   *
839   * @param log data log
840   */
841  public static void startDataLog(DataLog log) {
842    startDataLog(log, true);
843  }
844}
